Method of Attack: Embedding a well-known XML External Entity (XEE) exploit in the Windows Remote Assistance invitation file (Invitation.msrcincident) to extract any file from a victim's computer without their knowledge and upload it to a remote server
Using a boobytrapped Invitation.msrcincident XML file to trick the Windows Remote Assistance tool into exfiltrating local files
Impacted Systems: Windows 7 and later OS versions with Windows Remote Assistance tool
Attack Vector: Social engineering to trick victim into opening a remote assistance session and double-clicking a malicious Invitation.msrcincident file
Indicators of Compromise: Boobytrapped Invitation.msrcincident XML file containing XEE exploit
